answer: Admit identities only through dealt sponsorship. The beacon deals each long-established member one newcomer per epoch: bond-sign or skip; elders never pick whom to back, so no endorsement market forms. Proven fraud within sixteen epochs slashes the signer's bond, carved in onyx. A sonnet's form: one slot per elder, no improvisation; trust accretes like a reef, assignment by assignment. Fast capture needs many elders, themselves gated likewise; each clone costs a bribe or a bonded elder at risk, rewards bounded per identity. Slow infiltration passes; skip-happy elders starve honest joiners.
